cases.trigger: The deterministic write-review candidate has no granted permission evidence.
cases.recovery: An accountable human may provide current bounded permission evidence and request a new preview.

cases.trigger: The exact target version differs from the version bound to the outbound preview.
cases.recovery: Re-read the bounded target, recompute the delta, and require a new human confirmation.

cases.trigger: The local returned-snapshot fixture conflicts with the exact outbound design-package candidate.
cases.recovery: Route the exact conflict set to accountable human resolution before any approval or baseline candidate is reconsidered.
